subject: expression: `expression.BuildSimpleExpr` supports to build `ParamMarker` (#55493)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its parent. The change makes `ParamMarkerExpr` rewritable in `buildSimpleExpr` by refactoring `expression.ParamMarkerExpression` to accept `expression.BuildContext` and adjusting planner call sites; adds a focused test that builds/evaluates an expression containing `?` with a `StaticExprContext` param list. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness/SQL semantics/session-runtime handling within the touched expression/planner paths.
